Subject: Observability add-on pricing — retention and tracing questions

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We have two immediate follow-ups from our infra and security teams:

1) Retention: We need 13 months of full traces (spans + annotations) and 2 years of aggregated metrics/logs. Can you outline the cost drivers for long retention vs rolling window / archive?
2) Tracing queries: Our SREs run ad-hoc queries — how do query credits/ingestion vs. storage trade off?
3) Dashboards: We want the advanced dashboards bundle for cross-team views; is that a separate SKU or bundled with retention?

We're finalizing budget for next quarter and would appreciate a couple of example pricing scenarios (monthly cost + expected per-query/ingest line items) and any commitment/discount options you offer.

Thanks — Claire

Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing — retention and tracing questions

Hi Claire — great questions, thanks for the clear requirements. High level answers first, then I attached a short spreadsheet with three priced scenarios.

TL;DR: retention costs are dominated by (a) hot storage per GB-month for full trace spans, (b) query credit consumption for ad-hoc trace searches, and (c) dashboard compute for long-range analytics. We offer two patterns:

- Tiered retention (recommended): 30/90/365/13-month tiers with automatic cold-archive after N days. Hot storage for the first 90 days is priced higher, then archive is ~10–20% of hot.
- Committed retention + credits: you commit to monthly GB ingest/retention and we give a pool of query credits + discounted dashboard compute.

Attached: observability_pricing_v3.pdf and acme_retention_scenarios.xlsx — Scenario A is low-ingest (10GB/day), Scenario B mid (50GB/day), Scenario C high (200GB/day).

Key numbers from the sheet (examples):
- Base observability add-on: $0.035 per GB-month (hot), $0.004 per GB-month (cold archive)
- Trace query credits: $0.12 per heavy query (full-span scan) or $0.0009 per trace indexed (for sampled analytical queries)
- Advanced dashboards: $1,200 / month for org-level bundle (up to 25 editors) or $0.035 per dashboard-hour for ad-hoc compute

Discounting: we can offer tiered commit discounts (12-month commit) — 10% at $30k ARR committed, 18% at $100k, and a one-time onboarding credit for new customers. For your 13-month retention ask, the committed retention path usually reduces overall cost by ~15–25% vs purely hot storage.

Next steps: I recommend a short call with our SRE pricing worksheet (15–20 minutes) to map your ingest profile to one of the scenarios. When convenient, I can also share a DocuSign term sheet for a pilot commit.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Quick note from pricing: two tactical levers that usually help close deals like this —

1) First-year promotional discount: we can apply a 20% promotional discount on the observability add-on for Q1 to reduce friction for the pilot, conditional on a 12-month commitment to the base API usage. This helps offset the higher hot-storage costs early on.

2) Query credit bundling: instead of per-query billing, we can offer a prepaid credit bucket sized to your forecast with overage at the same per-unit rate; that often simplifies SRE budgeting and avoids spikes.

If Claire can share a 30-day ingest sample (even sums by day), we can hand back a committed credit recommendation and a sample amortized monthly charge with the promotional discount applied. Happy to jump on the call.

Ben
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference

Thanks Tim — attached is a short table (also in the HubSpot link) with the requested deltas for 50GB/day ingest. Executive summary below and proposed next steps.

Executive summary (50GB/day example):
- Model A (no commit): ~$34,200 / month — dominated by hot trace storage and higher per-query costs.
- Model B (12-mo commit + 20% promo): ~$26,760 / month — promotional credit applied to observability add-on and dashboard bundle; requires 12-mo commit to base API usage (~est. 2.5M tokens/month).
- Model C (committed retention + credit bucket): ~$23,500 / month — lower long-term cost by committing to retention and prebuying query credits; additional 10% discount available for multi-year commit.

Advanced dashboards: $1,200 onboarding (one-time) + $900 / month for the bundle at your size; we can amortize onboarding over the first 12 months if that helps budget.

- Please send the 30-day ingest csv; we'll finalize the committed-credit recommendation.

- I'll include a DocuSign pilot term with the promotional discount for your legal review.
